design_description: A bold heritage-driven design inspired by Aztec visual culture, using a deep black base covered with intricate red geometric symbols and ornamental motifs. A large circular Aztec calendar-inspired graphic dominates the lower front, creating a powerful focal point while the upper pattern remains more dispersed for crest and sponsor visibility. Red-on-black tonal execution keeps the dense artwork cohesive and sophisticated, with subtle gold details adding warmth and contrast. Decorative geometric borders around the collar and sleeve cuffs extend the indigenous-inspired visual language throughout the entire jersey. Overall, the design feels intense, cultural, and distinctive, translating Tijuana's Mexican identity into a modern football aesthetic.
